Name: Witchy Jester
Author: neosinf
Description:
====================================
Witchy Jester
====================================

Do you want a supernatural dark kitty to follow you on your witchy adventures? This is the answer!

This mod doesn't do anything on it's own. Instead it tells Stardew Druid, the main mod, to load an alternative sprite collection for the NPC Jester when the game is loaded.

[color=#f6b26b]NOTE: Because the assets for this mod are packaged in Stardew Druid, this extension does not need to be downloaded and installed to be enabled for players who have 'gothic versions' set to true in their Stardew Druid configuration file.[/color]

Jester is a companion NPC with follow/fight/help routines that the player meets about halfway through a Stardew Druid playthrough. Jester can be met immediately by using the Set Progress configuration option in Stardew Druid and setting it to 13 or higher.

This mod can be enabled and disabled without affecting save files or progression in Stardew Druid.

Main mod:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18465

Discord server:
discord.gg/XK29PHPqSg

==========================================
SETUP
==========================================

Download and install SMAPI

Download and install Stardew Druid version 3.5.3 or later by Neosinf

Please see the Stardew Druid main page for more information on credits and licenses
